newsitem.title: USA: Stant sees '96 Q4 comparable to '95 Q4.
newsitem.headline: Stant sees '96 Q4 comparable to '95 Q4.

text.p: Stant Corp said Thursday it expects fourth quarter earnings and sales to be comparable to the year-ago period when it reported net income of $5.4 million or $0.33 per share on sales of $162.5 million.
"Our outlook for the year remains positive as we expect the fourth quarter will be comparable to last year's strong fourth quarter," said president David Paridy in a statement.
A spokesman for the company did not elaborate.

Stant also said it expects to complete by the end of the year its recently announced acquisition of Lubrimatic, a grease-gun business with annual sales of about $30 million, from Southwest Petro-Chem Inc.
Stant manufactures automotive windshield wiping systems and windshield wiper blades.
